title: Value-Aligned Prompt Moderation via Zero-Shot Agentic Rewriting for Safe Image Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning AI image generation with human values, ethics, and social norms. It explicitly identifies 'representational ethics' and 'social norms' as core components of its framework. Furthermore, it utilizes a 'Value-Level Detection' module and evaluates its system on the 'Value-412' dataset, which specifically includes religious sites (e.g., churches, mosques, temples) and ethical considerations as critical benchmarks for safety.
